children: Live Nation Entertainment priced $730,000,000 of 7.125% senior notes and €600,000,000 of 6.125% senior notes due 2032.
Placed $730M U.S. notes at 7.125% and €600M euro notes at 6.125%, each issued at 100.000% of face value.
Offering closes October 15, 2026, subject to customary closing conditions and private placement restrictions.
Notes will be guaranteed by the company and its existing/future domestic restricted subsidiaries.
Entered cross-currency swaps converting $730M into ~€652M through Oct 2031, creating a blended interest rate ~5.89% across the Notes.
Net proceeds intended to redeem all outstanding 6.500% senior secured notes due 2027, pay offering costs, and for general corporate purposes.
